properties.note: B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP, CPCM(water) optimized pre-reaction ion-dipole complex (OH- paired with cis-cyclohexene oxide); lowest harmonic frequency 94.3 cm-1, no imaginary frequency.

Same ion-dipole pre-reaction complex used as the reference for the syn (frontside) channel; a separate frontside contact minimum does not exist at this level (an unconstrained optimization of the frontside arrangement drives OH- 4.6-4.9 A away from C2, jobs/rc_syn_optfreq.log).

Backside SN2 saddle: one imaginary frequency -496.6 cm-1; O1-C2 2.255 A forming, O3-C2 1.719 A breaking, O3-C4 1.401 A. IRC (ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0008/irc/irc.log) connects the ion-dipole complex to the trans-2-hydroxycyclohexan-1-olate, i.e. inversion at C2.

Frontside (retention) encounter: constrained optimization with d(O1-C2) fixed at 2.143 A and the face dihedral O1-C2-C4-O3 frozen (Opt=ModRedundant, B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP, CPCM water). No genuine first-order frontside C-O saddle exists: an unconstrained Opt=TS from this region collapses to an ion-dipole saddle with the epoxide intact (ts/ts_0002/jobs/declaration_0007/frequency/frequency.log, nu_imag -62.8 cm-1 with only 0.44 relative O1-C2 character). This energy is therefore an upper-bound estimate of the syn barrier, dominated by nucleophile-epoxide-oxygen repulsion.

trans-2-hydroxycyclohexan-1-olate (anti addition product): the IRC-connected product minimum (O1-C2 1.430 A, O3-C2 2.409 A), all frequencies real (lowest 165.7 cm-1). A separately built trans conformer is 1.6 kcal/mol higher (jobs/p_trans_optfreq.log, -385.532569619).
cis-2-hydroxycyclohexan-1-olate (syn/retention product), all frequencies real (lowest 146.2 cm-1).
